title: Alchemy Tales v2.0.0 Update Notes : Massive new content & Sect Management system is now live!
author: Ok-Construction6990
selftext:
# New Features

# Ascension

Ascension is here! Refine pills and cultivate to True Immortal Perfection, then choose whether to carry your worldly supplies with you or leave them behind. Ascend, found your own sect, and begin a new chapter of sect management.

# Construction

Build facilities to establish your sect’s resource production, disciple training, and defenses. Adjacent buildings of the same type and level can merge and be upgraded together. Customize both building bodies and roofs with your own colors.

* **Resource Gathering:** Obtain herbs, wood, stone, Spirit Stones, and other essentials from Herb Gardens, Forests, Quarries, and Spirit Veins.
* **Crafting and Production:** Refine pills in the Alchemy Hall, forge equipment in the Forge Hall, craft talismans in the Talisman Hall, and create formation items in the Formation Hall. Unlock more advanced production as your sect develops.
* **Disciple Training:** Residences provide beds, while facilities such as the Sword Hall and Body Cultivation Hall support different training paths. Use the Library to discover and manage techniques.
* **Tribulations and Breakthroughs:** Send disciples who have perfected their current realm to the Tribulation Platform. A successful breakthrough allows them to continue cultivating. Upgrade the platform to improve their chances of success.
* **Spirit Beasts and Puppets:** Raise companions in the Spirit Beast Garden and craft puppets in the Puppet Workshop. Equip them to help disciples in battle.
* **Sect Defenses:** Deploy offensive formations, Mountain Guardian Arrays, and laser-firing Warships. Mountain Guardian Arrays protect buildings and disciples within their range.
* **Decoration:** Plan your sect’s layout with decorations and flooring, then customize building colors to create your own style.

https://i.redd.it/wk985pzw500i1.jpeg

# Purchasing

Purchase supplies for production, disciple development, and defense. Combine purchases with your sect’s gathering and crafting to build a reliable supply chain.

https://i.redd.it/mxypemvu500i1.jpeg

# Recruitment

Hold Recruitment Assemblies, test candidates’ Spirit Roots, and recruit suitable disciples. Recruitment requires available Residence beds and Spirit Stones. Batch testing and recruitment make it easier to manage larger groups of candidates.

https://i.redd.it/tq9v6fkz500i1.jpeg

# Disciples

Manage disciples’ assignments, cultivation, equipment, and techniques. Assign production and combat roles based on their cultivation and training paths to grow your sect.

* Assign disciples to work and cultivate in different facilities, contributing to resource production.
* Equip disciples with gear, techniques, spirit beasts, and puppets to strengthen them in battle.
* Arrange tribulations for disciples who have perfected their current realm, or send them to the Forbidden Grounds for training and rewards.
* Appoint Elders to help manage your sect.
* Disciples receive monthly wages. Unpaid wages reduce loyalty, and prolonged arrears may cause disciples to leave.

https://i.redd.it/hil1jj91600i1.jpeg

# Warehouse

Manage your sect’s supplies in one place. Sort, sell, and distribute resources for production and disciple development. Upgrade and expand your Warehouse to meet your sect’s growing storage needs.

https://i.redd.it/zka2pb13600i1.jpeg

# Sect Defense

Repel invading cultivators with disciples, formations, and laser-firing Warships. Challenge increasingly powerful waves and earn rewards.

* Enemy forces vary in size between waves. Enemy Warships can transport cultivators onto the battlefield.
* Order disciples to move or focus their attacks, adjusting your defenses as the battle unfolds.
* Upgrade formations and Warships to strengthen your defenses. Warship lasers deal sustained damage and pierce enemies along their path.
* Review battle reports and rewards after combat, repair damaged buildings with one click, and challenge the next wave.
* If the Main Hall falls, the remaining buildings are destroyed and the sect collapses. Rebuild and prepare to fight again.
* Join the battle as the Sect Leader. Equip player-exclusive techniques and unleash powerful abilities to support your disciples.

https://i.redd.it/pdovwrf5600i1.jpeg

# Spiritual Inspection

Inspect buildings and cultivators to view combat information, building conditions, and formation coverage. Use this information to plan your sect’s layout and defenses.

# Other Additions

* Added automatic crash report uploads to help the developer investigate crashes. This can be enabled or disabled in Settings.
* Added multiple save slots for saving and loading separate playthroughs.
* Added ascension animations, with different sequences for carrying supplies or scattering them before ascending.
* Added resource collection animations and sound effects for clearer feedback inside buildings and on the main map.
* Added a combo counter to expeditions, along with improved damage numbers, attack effects, and sounds.
* Expanded the selection of herbs, pills, weapons, armor, techniques, spirit beasts, puppets, formations, and more.
* Added sect milestone achievements and badges to commemorate founding, training, and defensive accomplishments.
* Added a sect Ledger to track Spirit Stone income, expenses, and inventory, helping you plan construction and wage payments.
* Expanded the Log and Codex to record important sect events and display discovered items and buildings.
* Added an ebook-style Cultivation Handbook with a table of contents, search, and page navigation for gameplay instructions and item information.
* Added automatic map expansion at the edges and exploration fog, providing more room for your sect to grow.
* Added dates and day tracking to show the passage of time.
* Added a day and night cycle with different lighting and atmosphere.
* Added spring, summer, autumn, and winter. Ground colors change with the seasons, with consistent seasonal palettes outdoors and inside buildings.

# Improvements

* Improved saber and hammer attack ranges for a better melee combat experience.
* Improved skill tree guidance and unlocking, with clearer effects, prerequisites, and unlock states.
* Rebalanced cultivation progression, resource production, and consumption.
* Improved layouts at different resolutions, with more consistent dialog sizes, button placement, and content spacing.
* Improved material throwing: drag materials directly from the Storage Bag into furnaces, with bubbles above eligible furnaces showing where they can be used.
* Streamlined purchase and reward notifications for smoother interactions.
* Improved Fortune minigame layouts, keeping titles, content, and controls closer together.
* Added first-time feature unlock bubbles to introduce new functions and guide players to them.
* Added prerequisite messages explaining why an action is unavailable and what to do next.
* Improved item readability with consistent names, quality colors, slot backgrounds, and icons.
* Skill cooldowns now display in seconds.
* Improved background play: the game continues while minimized, while manually pausing still pauses gameplay.
* Improved multilingual display and fixed various known issues.

Thank you to all our fellow cultivators for your support and feedback!
